editorial_review.notes: Eight candidates were independently discovered before consulting the tracker. Four fresh developments are November 1 national campaign activity, November 2 Columbus Council meeting, November 2 UAD 3.6 mandate effective date, and the current November 2 forecast; the weather card is compact and does not carry the editorial freshness burden. Both specialist beats are explicitly dated updates within seven days. Facts and takeaways were compared against the seven prior scripts; UAD changes from background to effective operational mandate and the AI items introduce new entities and conclusions.
